exposure: mobile health (mHealth) intervention (nurse's online guidance via mobile App plus regular offline clinical treatment)
outcome: blood glucose control (HbA1C, fasting and 2h post-prandial off-target measurements)
cohort: A total of 124 patients with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) were randomly divided into two groups.
finding: Mobile health intervention for GDM patients significantly improved compliance, blood glucose control (lower HbA1C and reduced off-target measurements), and reduced weight gain, thereby decreasing the rates of complications in both pregnant women and fetuses during pregnancy and delivery.
